name: CaseAntdPartTransitionChannel
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-part-transition-channel" (motion). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: .cf-a { transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1) } — a transition declared on a CHILD PART, not the root (antd's `motionDurationMid` on every interactive part)
